disclaimer: Simulated data, decision support, not a medical device.

cards.title: Regulatory T-Cell (Treg) Modulation in Spaceflight
cards.plain_summary: Observational spaceflight studies report alterations in regulatory T-cell proportions and suppressor activity during orbital missions.
cards.why_it_matters: Altered immune cell distribution shifts adaptive immune response context in microgravity. Check with flight surgeon for surveillance context.
sources: Crucian et al., J. Leukocyte Biology

cards.title: Latent Virus Reactivation Surveillance
cards.plain_summary: Subclinical shedding of latent herpesviruses (EBV, VZV, CMV) has been documented in astronauts during spaceflight due to physical and microgravity stressors.
cards.why_it_matters: Tracking shedding biomarker trends provides objective context for cellular immune status without indicating clinical status. Check with flight surgeon.
sources: Rooney et al., Frontiers in Microbiology

cards.title: Circadian Light Phase Regulation
cards.plain_summary: Dynamic solid-state lighting schedules modulate spectral irradiance and illuminance aboard spacecraft to synchronize human circadian clocks.
cards.why_it_matters: Maintains circadian phase alignment, cognitive operational readiness, and nocturnal sleep quality across orbital mission cycles.
sources: Brainard et al., Lighting Research & Technology

cards.title: Galactic Cosmic Rays & Solar Particle Event Dosimetry
cards.plain_summary: Beyond low Earth orbit, crew members encounter ionizing cosmic rays and intermittent solar particle events requiring cumulative dosimetry.
cards.why_it_matters: Dosimetric trend tracking provides critical environmental context to optimize active vehicle shielding and EVA scheduling under ALARA principles.

cards.title: Cephalad Fluid Redistribution
cards.plain_summary: In microgravity, the absence of hydrostatic pressure gradients causes approximately two liters of body fluid to shift toward the chest and head.
cards.why_it_matters: Induces central venous engorgement and physiological remodeling trends. Monitoring baseline shift guides countermeasure fluid-loading protocols.

cards.title: Sleep Architecture & Behavioral Rhythmicity
cards.plain_summary: Microgravity, altered sleep berths, and mission operations frequently fragment restorative slow-wave and REM sleep architecture.
cards.why_it_matters: Restorative sleep trends directly underpin neurobehavioral readiness, executive decision capability, and physical resilience on long-duration exploration.
sources: NASA Behavioral Health and Performance Division
